title: A local diagram namespace is a reference domain for nearby text
summary: V75 R2 states that the two f67r2 wheels are copied separately and not computed together. The hypothesis is a functional text reference to a local register, with no planet or calendar naming.

design.unit: source-bound complete records or visual-text contexts named in source_observation
design.prediction: text associated with one wheel should reuse only that wheel’s local reference domain; a cross-wheel or decorative model predicts no namespace restriction
design.countermodel: The source model is authored and may merely describe an image; this proposal needs an independent text-side consequence.
design.falsifier: A held text construction crosses namespaces in a predeclared way while retaining the same supposed local-reference form, or no text record shows any local restriction.
design.principal_risk: No independently bound referent or action; exact 74-case model remains unconfirmed.

evidence.quote:
### f67r2 — PAIRED_BUT_DISCONNECTED_CELESTIAL_REFERENCE_WHEELS

**Arbeitslesung:** Zwei getrennte Himmelsräder: rechts ein zwölfteiliger Zeichen-/Kalenderrahmen mit eigenen Ring- und Bedingungsfeldern, links ein Stern-/Strahlenrad mit lokalen Innen- und Außenplätzen. Beide werden nebeneinander kopiert, aber nicht miteinander verrechnet.

design.smallest_test: Select two existing f67r2 text records with documented local ownership and tabulate namespace plus reference-like relation; no new image reading.
design.selection_status: raw_unreviewed; no readiness or novelty claim
